versions.changelog:
lobsterai-report-agent 1.0.1

- No file or code changes detected in this release.
- All features and behavior remain identical to the previous version.

lobsterai-report-agent v4.0.0 — Major refactor and enhancement update

- Core codebase refactored into src/config.py (I/O & config), src/engine.py (core logic), src/cli.py (CLI entry).
- integrate_report.py retained as a backward-compatible facade for existing interfaces.
- Configurable file paths and output directories via environment variables (LOBAI_CHAPTERS_DIR / LOBAI_OUTPUT_DIR).
- Notification channels now configurable (log, feishu, or openclaw-weixin).
- Mermaid CLI is now lazily loaded for improved performance.
- README.md and LICENSE files added for open-source use.
- Enhanced multi-Agent parallel writing, incremental updates, and polished DOCX export with multiple cover styles.
- See SKILL.md for updated CLI commands, configuration, and pipeline details.
